title: SparseX: Efficient Segment-Level KV Cache Sharing for Interleaved LLM Serving
authors: Quqing Zhang; Kai Chen; Ning Liao; Zehao Lin; Bo Tang; Feiyu Xiong; Zhiyu Li; Xiaoxing Wang
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Repeated content in multi-round chat, RAG, and agent workflows often appears as interleaved non-prefix segments, beyond the hit condition of conventional Prefix Cache. Direct arbitrary-position KV cache reuse is inaccurate because a segment's hidden states and KV tensors depend on both its prefix context and position.
problem_statement.zh: 多輪對話、RAG 與 agent workflow 中的重複內容，經常以交錯的非 prefix segment 出現，超出傳統 Prefix Cache 的命中條件。由於 segment 的 hidden state 與 KV tensor 同時依賴其 prefix context 與位置，直接進行任意位置的 KV cache 重用會造成精度損失。

key_innovation.en: SparseX uses receiver-side non-reuse queries as Sparse-Q probes to rank reused tokens by accumulated attention, selectively recomputes the top-k tokens, and RoPE-aligns the rest. A layer-specific full+sparse hybrid performs full attention in early layers before switching to Sparse-KV Recomputation, all integrated into vLLM's paged-cache and attention execution path.
key_innovation.zh: SparseX 將接收端的非重用 query 作為 Sparse-Q probe，依 accumulated attention 排序重用 token，僅重算 top-k token，並對其餘 token 執行 RoPE alignment。其 layer-specific full+sparse hybrid 在早期 layer 使用 full attention，之後切換至 Sparse-KV Recomputation，且完整整合於 vLLM 的 paged-cache 與 attention execution path。

baselines_compared: Full recompute, Naive reuse, CacheBlend, EPIC, Vanilla

key_improvements.en: On Qwen3-32B LOCOMO, SparseX with hybrid attention preserves a 0.67 score versus 0.68 for full recompute while reducing TTFT from 9.23 s to 0.87 s. On RULER, its average scores reach 0.94–0.98 across the evaluated Qwen3 models, close to or above full recompute at 0.94–0.97.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B LOCOMO 上，啟用 hybrid attention 的 SparseX 將 score 維持於 0.67，相較 full recompute 為 0.68，同時把 TTFT 由 9.23 s 降至 0.87 s。在 RULER 上，其於各 Qwen3 模型的平均 score 達 0.94–0.98，接近或高於 full recompute 的 0.94–0.97。

reuse_scope: Cross-agent (same backbone), Cross-context RAG, Cross-request / multi-tenant, Cross-position

reuse_metric.en: On Qwen3-32B LOCOMO, SparseX with full+sparse hybrid attention retains a 0.67 quality score versus 0.68 for full recompute while lowering TTFT from 9.23 s to 0.87 s.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B LOCOMO 上，採用 full+sparse hybrid attention 的 SparseX 將品質 score 維持於 0.67，相較 full recompute 為 0.68，並將 TTFT 由 9.23 s 降至 0.87 s。
